model.title: Combating Illicit Xylazine Act
model.meta: Judiciary Committee, Energy and Commerce Committee · Rep. Jimmy Panetta (D-CA)

summary.text: The bill would classify xylazine, a veterinary sedative increasingly found mixed with fentanyl in illegal drugs, as a controlled substance under federal law. This would make manufacturing and distributing it illegally subject to criminal penalties, require tracking of xylazine transactions, and exempt legitimate veterinary and animal-control uses; the measure also directs federal agencies to study and report on the extent of illicit xylazine use and trafficking.
